name: Zovo Invoice
tagline: Create and manage VAT invoices with business profiles and PDF export
description: Generate VAT-compliant invoices from a business profile, line items and clients, with PDF export. Hosted remote MCP server (streamable HTTP) with a focused tool set; runs at https://mcp.zovo.one/mcp/invoice. A free access token can be minted at https://mcp.zovo.one/mcp/connect and passed as an Authorization: Bearer header for tool calls; listing tools works anonymously. Source: https://github.com/theluckystrike/mcp-servers. Also available on npm as @theluckystrike/mcp-invoice.
